name: 98841 · Omak, WA
findings: ZIP 98841 (Omak) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98841 (Omak) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
80% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
